rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Drac de Sant Llorenc del Munt, the fierce flying dragon that ravaged the Catalan mountain massif.
ANATOMY: one fierce dragon with one head, two eyes, a running animal body and two bird-of-prey-like wings; no elaborate horns or invented ornaments [drac-de-sant-llorenc-del-munt-c01, drac-de-sant-llorenc-del-munt-c04]
MOMENT: surge out of the dripping mountain cave toward the viewer, jaws open, wings unfolding, forefeet grinding loose stones.
POWER: physical destruction of crops and livestock is documented; show only stones dislodged by its rush, no fire breath or magical effect [drac-de-sant-llorenc-del-munt-c01, drac-de-sant-llorenc-del-munt-c04]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; tightly framed creature fills the square, no invented giant scale or human comparison.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one shaft of late sunset from outside the cave, rim light, cave moisture and natural stone dust.
SURFACE: rough dark reptilian hide, dusty claws, damp stone, weathered wing membranes.
SETTING: water-seeping cave on Sant Llorenc del Munt [drac-de-sant-llorenc-del-munt-c09]
MOOD: menacing; dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons. No fire breath, lightning, glyphs or tattoos.
depicted_variant: Flying dragon emerging from its documented mountain cave.

visual_requirements.description: Fierce dragon capable of running and flying, single readable dragon subject.
Animal rush physically dislodges stones, no magic or fire breath.

aura: Threat from ravaging dragon identity and running/flying action (c01,c04).
artistic_choices: Dark reptilian surface and conventional dragon limb geometry are editorial concretizations of the dragon identity, not separately documented anatomical facts.
Sunset, close framing and dust are editorial; no enlarged scale or fire breath.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: all seven Sangar checks pass. Single readable dragon head, two wings and visible forelegs; rushing cave emergence, damp rock and physical debris, no magical effects, text or ornamental glyphs. Conventional reptilian details are editorial, not source-specific anatomy.

root_visual_review.notes: Winged dragon lunging out of a dripping mountain cave, scattering stones [c01, c04, c09]. Single subject, no fire.
